shared_elements: low-relief carving on a tall upright stone slab/monolith
elaborate headdress-like ornamentation at the top
justification: Both are tall upright slabs bearing shallow relief with curvilinear scrolls and blocky repeated sign-like units, and both concentrate ornament in a headdress-like zone at the top, which gives a weak stylistic kinship. But A depicts a single large anthropomorphic body — head, shoulders, torso with a prominent circular disc on the chest and a belt-like band — while B shows only stacked rectangular panels of dense glyph-like motifs with no discernible body or figure, so the organizing scheme is quite different.
